description: This file defines a React functional component named TestWizard, which implements a two-step wizard for creating a test. It handles form state, validation with zod, API interaction for test creation, and user notifications.

methods.name: TestWizard
methods.description: React functional component providing a wizard UI to create a test with name and optional description.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances to the next step in the wizard.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step in the wizard.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, creates a test via API, triggers notification, and calls optional callback.
